title: lore graph: add --limit to bound the emitted neighbours (DEC-193)
description:
CLI slice of LCLI-671, split out under DEC-193 (opum-ai/opum-doc#1005). Design of record: opum-doc docs/reference/lore-pane-links-and-graph-design.md.

DEC-193 rules the surface for the neighbour list: it is NEITHER a `read` option NOR a new command. `lore graph <id> --depth 1 --json` already returns inbound and outbound neighbours with edge kinds as `{from, to, kind}`, and `read` stays "exactly as authored, no assembly". The only CLI addition is `--limit <N>` on `lore graph`.

Add ONLY that: nearest-first by depth, a stable order within a depth, and when the limit cuts the emission, `truncated` plus a total in the envelope. Report issues to opum-doc; make no design calls.

acceptanceCriteria.text: lore graph <id> --limit N emits at most N neighbours, nearest-first by depth, in a stable order within each depth.
When the limit cuts the emission the envelope carries truncated: true plus the total neighbour count; when it does not, truncated: false and the total equals the emitted count.
Proved both ways: a subgraph already within the limit is emitted unchanged, and one over it is cut with the truncation named.
